notes.title: Insane All games update
notes.content:
1. All games engines was updated to new version, games now work smooth and perfectly clean
Ne Padai! - 2017.4.1f1 
The last Baron's stunt (Anime) - 2017.4.1f1 
Neon Universe - 2017.4.1f1 
Other Worlds India - 2017.4.1f1 


2. All games Steamworks libraries was updated to version 13.0, every steam enviroment now works perfect, achievements, progress, etc.
Ne Padai! - SteamSDK 1.46 
The last Baron's stunt (Anime) - SteamSDK 1.46 
Neon Universe - SteamSDK 1.46 
Other Worlds India - SteamSDK 1.46 

3. All games was frame locked to avoid image gap/other visual bugs
Ne Padai! - 60FPS 
The last Baron's stunt (Anime) - 60FPS 
Neon Universe - 60FPS 
Other Worlds India - 60FPS 

4. All games now have RU/ENG localization
Ne Padai! - ru/eng 
The last Baron's stunt (Anime) - ru/eng 
Neon Universe - ru/eng 
Other Worlds India - ru/eng
